info.title: Pool Tables Manager API
info.description:
REST API for Pool Tables Manager.

**Authentication:** most admin endpoints require a signed-in session. Log in with `POST /auth/local/login` (local admin) or through OIDC (`GET /auth/login`). Swagger UI keeps the session cookie for same-origin "Try it out" calls.

Endpoints marked **Public** work without a session. `GET /api/settings` returns a public-safe subset unless authenticated.

post.summary: Log in with the local admin password (sets the session cookie)

get.summary: Log out (destroys the session; ends the OIDC session when possible)

delete.summary: Clear the local admin password (allow re-bootstrap)

get.summary: Read settings (public-safe subset when not authenticated)
get.description: Unauthenticated callers receive only app_name, currency, public_base_url, subscriber_discount, dashboard_layout and table_type_order. Authenticated admins get all settings except secrets (`smtp_pass` is never returned).

post.summary: Send a test email with the configured SMTP

delete.summary: Delete all unclosed session history (closed VAT periods are preserved)

get.summary: Download a compressed database backup (pg_dump custom format)

post.summary: Restore a database backup (validated, single transaction, then migrations)
Add several tables of a type

put.summary: Update a table (number, status, type) — duplicate numbers return 409

patch.summary: Update players / subscriber count (clamped to players)
End a session without issuing a receipt

post.summary: Checkout: discount, payments (cash/card), receipt and table release
Transfer a session to another table
Add an item to the tab
Start a card payment on the terminal (amount capped at the total due; idempotent)

get.summary: Recent payments (with table numbers; stale card statuses re-synced)

post.summary: Refund a payment (invoiced payments get a credit note)

get.summary: Current shift with expected drawer total

post.summary: Close a shift (counted cash, expected, variance)

get.summary: VAT report by rate/category (credit notes subtracted)
Day reconciliation (payments by method, credit notes, cash shifts, terminal totals)

post.summary: Close the day (creates a day closure with reconciliation snapshot)

get.summary: Live table availability (no PINs or tab data)
Player table view data (requires the session PIN)

post.summary: Place a drink order from the table view

post.description: Requires the raw request body and a valid Stripe-Signature header. Configured in the Stripe dashboard.
